senses.gloss: m. (= <he>תאריס</he>, v. <cite ref="A03210"><he>אָרַס</he></cite> a. denom.; cmp. <cite ref="V00080"><he>תָּגָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="V00009"><he>תָּאגָא</he></cite>)

units: Kel. XXIV, 1 שלשה תריסין הן ת׳ כפוף וכ׳ there are three sorts of shields (with regard to levitical cleanness): the bent shield (which may be used as an improvised seat) is unclean as midras (v. מִדְרָס), and that with which they play in the camp &c., v. דִּיצָה.

Midr. Till. to Ps. I; Yalk. ib. 833 (ref. to מגן, Ps. LXXXIV, 12) [read:] הת׳ שמקיף וכ׳ (איסקוטא פרסאה, איש׳, being a gloss, v. טַארְגָא) that is the taris, which protects man on three sides, contrad. to צִנָּה.
Ab. IV, 11 תשובה … כת׳ בפני הפורענות repentance and good deeds are as a shield against misfortune; [oth. opin: as a shutter, v. infra).—Pl. תָּרִיסִין. Kel. l. c.
Ber. 27ᵇ; Bekh. 36ᵃ בעלי ת׳ shield-bearers, i.e. great debaters.—2) (cmp. נַעַל) shutter.— Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:5">Bets. I, 5</cite> <he>אין מסלקין את הת׳ וכ׳</he> you must not remove (take apart) shutters on the Holy Day; expl.

<cite ref="Beitzah 11b:4">ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>תְּרֵיסֵי חנויות</he> shutters of shops. Y. ib. I, 60ᶜ, v. <cite ref="L00363"><he>לָחַם</he> I</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:1:6">Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᶜ</cite> <he>התירצין</he> (read: <he>התְּרִיצִין</he>).
